what: DJI controller (the owner's DJI RC 3) on USB: what Windows, Chrome and the simulator saw, 2026-10-15, owner's PC (Windows 11 26200)

hidCaps.method: hid.dll HidD_GetAttributes / HidD_GetProductString / HidP_GetCaps / HidP_GetValueCaps / HidP_GetButtonCaps
hidCaps.note: valueCaps in the order HidP_GetValueCaps returned them; the byte order inside the report was not read (the controller was unplugged before the raw-report probe ran)

recording.method: winmm joyGetPosEx polled for 40 s (5 ms sleep, 5-7 ms between polls, about 165 polls a second), only changes kept; the owner stirred the sticks (about 0-25 s), then switches and buttons and the wheel
recording.rest: x -11 and u (Rx) -8 in the controller's units with jitter of a few units; y, z and r exactly 0; buttons 0x50 (bits 4 and 6)

chrome152InClaudeApp.liveTrace40s: axes 0-3 reached -1 and +1 while stirring (150-170 changes a second), axis 4 (the wheel) reached -1..+1 only when turned (30-31 s), button bitmask 80 at rest
chrome152InClaudeApp.simulatorGamepadPath: release 55fbccae0af5 on the live site, ?render=off: the Controls screen's gamepad button started the wizard (screenshot live-gamepad-path-stir-chrome152.jpg); the stir passed (5 stick-like channels: the owner turned the wheel too); at the Throttle step the owner's free movement gave 'wizard.hint.push.two' 11 times and 'push.hold' 4 times in 30 s and no push was taken (wizardLog below); a clean one-stick push was not recorded

chrome140OwnersBrowser.getGamepads: [null, null, null, null] in a visible, focused tab with the controller at rest; the simulator's gamepad source ran for about 4 s and received no frame (gp.index -1)
chrome140OwnersBrowser.notChecked: the same with a stick moved (browsers expose a pad only after an input)

webhidPathBeforeFix: the chooser filters already take usage page 1 usage 4/5/8, so the controller is listed; every 13-byte report failed parseEdgeTxReport (it needs 19 or 16 bytes and more), HidSource counted it as bad, the wizard stayed at connect with 'The radio sends 13-byte reports we cannot read'
fix: HidSource reads a non-EdgeTX device through its descriptor (packages/input/src/hid-layout.ts, makeHidReader); EdgeTX keeps its fixed layout
